purpose: Open examples; select, combine or write a new profile for the actual brief. No song notes, key, track counts, tempo or loudness targets are encoded.

profiles.intent: Large, clear ensemble with approachable contemporary colours
profiles.identity_policy: preserve theme, form and functional harmony unless requested otherwise
profiles.development: Set participation, register and dynamics for actual sections; maintain orchestral body when modern colours enter.
profiles.sound: Acoustic samples or DAW instruments; probe articulations.
profiles.mix: Protect theme and rhythmic attacks; assess low-mid density and upper-register sharpness.

profiles.intent: User-defined 1980s electronic palette; distinguish synthwave, vaporwave and cyberpunk targets
profiles.identity_policy: preserve melody/form; tempo changes or reharmonization only when requested
profiles.development: Vary timbre, rhythm and register across the actual form instead of repeating a single loop.
profiles.sound: Preset identities, seeds, envelope/filter curves and effects saved explicitly.
profiles.mix: Record delay timing, chorus, gated/plate returns and saturation; preserve clarity and section dynamics.

profiles.intent: Organic multi-part interpretation with culturally appropriate instrument choices
profiles.identity_policy: preserve theme/form; ornaments labelled as arrangement additions
profiles.development: Use breathing, articulation, registral exchange and varied accompaniment; density follows the brief.
profiles.sound: Validated samples or recorded/DAW stems; do not claim unsupported idiomatic techniques.
profiles.mix: Natural transients, believable space, separate foreground and accompaniment.
